newsitem.title: USA: Nutramax to market soft contact lens care.
newsitem.headline: Nutramax to market soft contact lens care.

text.p: Nutramax Products Inc announced the signing of an exclusive manufacturing and supply agreement on Monday to market Multi-Purpose Solution for soft contact lens care in the United States.
Multi-Purpose Solutions are the largest segment of the retail eye care market, generating $300 million in annual sales. The company anticipates first shipments in November 1996.
Nutramax manufactures and markets private label health and personal care products. It also markets a line of contact lens care products.
